findings.title: website_name leaks websites that are hidden as untrusted attributes
findings.body: website is listed in untrusted_attributes (lines 105-111), so it is hidden from anonymous viewers for TL0 users to prevent spam/abuse, but the newly added website_name attribute is not added to that list. An anonymous viewer of a TL0 profile therefore receives website_name, which is derived directly from the hidden website and reveals its host and, in the same-domain case, its full path, defeating the restriction and rendering the website link text even though website itself was withheld.

findings.title: include_website_name is missing the question mark and will never be called
findings.body: Every other conditional inclusion hook in this serializer is named include_<attribute>? (e.g. include_email?, include_card_image_badge_id?, include_stats?). The new hook is defined as include_website_name without the '?', so ActiveModel::Serializer will not use it to gate inclusion. website_name is therefore serialized even when website is blank, producing a website_name: nil key instead of omitting the attribute as intended.

findings.title: Root domain versus www subdomain is not treated as the same domain
findings.body: The same-domain check handles sibling subdomains of equal depth (www.example.com vs forum.example.com, lines 144-146) and a parent website domain (example.com vs forums.example.com, line 149), but not the common root/www pair: with Discourse at example.com and a website of http://www.example.com/user, the lengths differ (2 vs 3) so it falls to the else branch, example.com does not end with .www.example.com, and only www.example.com is returned without /user. The inverse direction works, so the displayed website name depends asymmetrically on which host carries the www prefix.

findings.title: website_name discards query string and fragment from the website URL
findings.body: When the website is on the instance domain, website_name is built as host + URI(website).path only. Any query string or fragment in the user's website (e.g. http://example.com/profile?tab=posts) is silently dropped from the displayed text, so the link label no longer shows the complete URL even though the stated purpose of the change is to show the complete URL path for same-domain websites.
